evidence.name: Screen field: Item subtitle text style
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Item subtitle text style" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Item subtitle text style
sections.description: Typography for the item subtitle — size, weight, color, alignment, line height, optional background, and padding, applied to all items as a shared template. Keep the subtitle visually quieter than the title (smaller, muted color) so it reads as supporting text. Only appears when your item layout includes a subtitle.
